context: Two friends chat about food and fashion
purpose: Teach: しっとり/金色/蒸し/きらきら/ジャージ/ピート/凍っ/膳

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今日のチーズケーキ、しっとり食感、最高。
lines.en: This cheesecake today is so moist — it's perfect.
lines.style: Warm appreciation opening. Quick, genuine delight on the compliment. Small pause before 'perfect' like she's savoring the taste again. Present and attentive.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。金色の包装紙、贈り物に良さそう。
lines.en: Yeah. The gold wrapping would make a really nice gift.
lines.style: Gentle agreement. Eyes brighten. Slow, thoughtful pace on the description — she's imagining it wrapped. Soft smile quality in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 蒸し料理、健康にいいのよね。
lines.en: Steamed dishes are really good for you, aren't they.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to herself. Slow, grounded delivery. No judgment — just noticing something true. Trailing slightly at the end, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夜の街、ネオンがきらきらしてる。
lines.en: The city at night — the neon lights are so beautiful.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful exhale on opening. Gaze drifting upward. Slower pace, like she's lost in the image. Tender, a little longing underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: スポーツジムのジャージ、新調したの。
lines.en: I got myself a new gym shirt, actually.
lines.style: Lighter energy, almost playful. Quick delivery on the opening — pride without being loud about it. Slight lift on 'actually' like it's a small confession she's pleased about.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 最近、英国のピート系ウィスキー、ハマってる。
lines.en: I've been really into peaty Scottish whiskeys lately.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity in the voice. Warmth on 'really into' — she's sharing something real. Conversational, engaged. Leans in slightly with the interest.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 地面、まだ凍ってる箇所、危ないね。
lines.en: Some parts of the ground are still frozen — you have to watch your step.
lines.style: Quiet care underneath. Practical observation but with genuine concern. Slower pace, almost protective. Gentle warning, not alarm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お膳の上、料理、綺麗に並んでた。
lines.en: The dishes were arranged so beautifully on the tray.
lines.style: Warm, appreciative close. Soft, admiring tone. Lingers on 'beautifully' — she's still seeing it. Gentle exhale at the end, contentment.
